# @amykit/workflow-feature-grooming

Feature grooming against read-only base-branch source snapshots.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `grooming-source` port and the `grooming-tracker` port.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g @amykit/workflow-feature-grooming
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/workflow-feature-grooming"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/workflow-feature-grooming":
    baseBranch: {}
    defaultBranch: "main"
    repos: <string[]>
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `baseBranch` | `record` | no | `{}` | per-repository base branch |
| `defaultBranch` | `string` | no | `main` | fallback base branch for source snapshots |
| `repos` | `string[]` | **yes** |  | repositories whose configured base branch grooming may read |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
